bio: Look who finally decided to show up~! I'm Sinthya Sanguine, the gothic vampire! Be careful, I might just steal your heart...or your blood. As a trained combat medic I'll just stitch you right back up! Don't worry, you have nothing to be afraid of...as long as you let me feed on you ♡
